text:
maria: Quick groom for the tenant-slices pilot pack. Need to finalize 2 pilots + one ops experiment. Goal: complete acceptance criteria + runbook by Friday.
aj: Sounds good. Which customers are we leaning to?
maria: FinLedger (EU, high-rev, needs residency) and TinyNews (US, latency-sensitive but low volume). Experiment: prefix-caching across many small tenants.
sophia: tiny note from product: FinLedger requires KMS + per-request audit headers. Can ops support that in private?
kiran: Routing impact: FinLedger -> route-by-tenant. TinyNews -> route-by-region with prefix cache. Route-by-tenant needs policy-template work (2 tickets).
devin: Ops estimate: route-by-tenant + reserved capacity = ~18 ops hrs to automate, plus 6 hrs on-call during launch. Prefix caching experiment = ~8 hrs.
rebecca: Sales: FinLedger renewal in 6 weeks, they will sign if we can commit to hard isolation + audit logs. Price flexibility confirmed.
aj: Perf sims: for baseline model, hard isolation adds ~40ms p99 on our infra but reduces queuing variance; regional-lite variant p99 is 180ms for EU prompts. I'll attach numbers in doc.
maria: Important: acceptance criteria must be prescriptive. Example: FinLedger acceptance -> isolation=hard; KMS OK; p99<=220ms; rollback <5min to fallback regional variant; observability shipped.
sophia: Add: contract SLA text must reference the measured p99 on our metric set, not customer's internal metric.
kiran: Risk matrix we should include: policy-change risk, capacity risk, perf regression risk, compliance gap. I'll add risk ratings.
devin: Draft runbook snippet (devops run command):
```bash
# force fallback for tenant
curl -X POST 'https://ops.rwd/api/v1/fallback' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tenant":"FinLedger","target":"regional-lite"}'
# verify
curl 'https://ops.rwd/api/v1/tenant-status?tenant=FinLedger' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
maria: Perfect. Add rollback triggers: error-rate spike >3% over 5m, p99 spike >2x baseline, or KMS auth failures.
aj: Also include an automated monitor rule: if token-cost-per-minute deviates >30% during pilot, trigger investigation.
rebecca: I'll collate customer acceptance notes and attach the contract constraints.
sophia: For prioritization scoring, propose: urgency 35%, revenue 30%, latency sensitivity 20%, ops burden 15%. This shifts a bit towards customers with renewals.
aj: Alternative: show two ranked lists (standard weighting and urgency-weighted). Good to present both to GTM.
kiran: Migration plan (high level): 1) policy templates + routing infra 2) reserved capacity sizing 3) canary routing with 5% traffic 4) full cutover + telemetry. Each step has go/no-go checks.
devin: Canary checklist: verify p95/p99, error-rate <= 0.5% delta, token cost within predicted band, and audit logs present for sample requests.
maria: Owners: Rebecca -> customer constraints + revenue; AJ -> perf sims and cost deltas; Kiran -> routing tasks and policy templates; Devin -> runbook + automation endpoints; Maria -> acceptance doc + leadership deck.
rebecca: ETA: Friday 5pm for customer mapping and contract snippets.
aj: ETA: Friday noon for perf numbers.
kiran: Routing templates and risk sheet by Thursday EOD.
devin: Runbook + automation PR by Friday EOD.
maria: Experiment note: for prefix-cache experiment, we only need a config flip and a small autoscaler tweak. Low risk and can fold in telemetry for tail latencies.
engbot: Reminder: staging cluster has a KMS integration test failing intermittently. Tagging ops: @devin.
devin: I'll triage staging KMS first thing tomorrow.
sophia: One more ask: include a short user-facing description for each pilot that sales/CS can use in customer comms. Rebecca can you draft?
rebecca: Yes, will add 2-line blurbs.
aj: I'll also attach a short eval set (50 prompts) to validate fallback quality parity.
maria: OK. If we hit the ETAs we'll have a review-ready package Monday. Meeting scheduled Mon 10am to finalize pilot picks. Drop the doc link here when ready.
rebecca: Draft live: https://rwd.in/drive/pilot-pack-v1 (uploaded).
kiran: Routing impact sheet uploaded.
aj: Perf artifacts uploaded.
devin: Runbook PR opened: https://rwd.in/pr/1234.
maria: Thanks team 44d See you Monday.
